name: Artaios

attributes.attribute: the Roman god he was equated with
the female bear deity of larger Continental worship

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Artaios is a Continental Celtic god. Some writers spell his name Artaius. He is a bear god, kin to the goddess of wisdom. MacKillop calls him an aspect of Gaulish Mercury. His name appears to mean bear god. He was equated with the Roman Mercury by some Gaul peoples. The female bear deity Artio is the larger Continental bear figure.

okr.objective: Record Artaios, a Continental bear god equated with Mercury.
key_results: Show his link to the female bear deity Artio.
